review.note: The record is the amendment instrument itself (Exhibit 3.03): it amends Article 4 of the charter and is signed by the Treasurer and Secretary. It only reports that the board and stockholders adopted the amendment; it is not a resolution or consent. The reviewer question set's own rule: the amendment instrument is charter_amendment.

evidence: We are in the process of determining which demand letter recipients will receive termination letters today.

review.note: HELD, not applied. The message is an internal Enron status email about which demand-letter recipients will get termination letters; it makes no demand itself, so a content reading gives email. But the arms do not agree (the LLM sorter answered email, the Decisions arm answered demand), and the Hub correspondence subclass follows a marker convention that question set 4.0.0 copies on purpose ('demand': a message that contains or discusses a demand, 'Mentions in an ordinary email count'). Correcting this one document would change the convention for one row and move H5 toward the arm that ignores it. Set verdict to correct only after the owner decides the correspondence subclass convention.
